summary: Launch checklist runs a list of pre-flight checks on a design before it ships, such as contrast, token use and alt text, and shows each result as it comes in. Failed checks get a Fix button so the agent can repair them, and the header button moves from running the checks to shipping.
use: When an agent should verify a page or component against your rules before it goes live.
When people need a quick summary of what still blocks a release.
When the agent can fix some failures by itself and people should trigger each fix.
When the final Ship it step should only be offered once every check passes.
features: Each check has a `label`, an optional `note` and a `state`: `wait`, `run`, `ok` or `bad`, each with its own glyph.
A segmented bar at the top fills in with green and red as checks finish.
The status line counts the checks, says Checking while one runs, then reports how many are left to fix or that all is clear. `status` overrides it.
A failed check with `onFix` shows a Fix button. Set the check back to `run` while the agent fixes it.
`action` adds a header button with a label, icon, `disabled` state and an `accent` colour for the step that ships.
Notes crossfade when they change, so "Checking" can turn into the result in place.
a11y: The bar has `role="progressbar"`, labelled with the title, and its `aria-valuenow` counts the checks that have finished, passed or failed.
Fix and the header action are real buttons, and the action can be disabled.

faq.q: Does the checklist run the checks itself?
faq.a: No. It shows the `checks` you pass. Your code or agent runs each check and updates its `state` and `note` as results arrive.

faq.q: How do I offer a fix for a failed check?
faq.a: Give that check an `onFix` handler while its state is `bad`. The Fix button calls it, and you can set the state to `run` with a note like "Fixing" until it passes.

faq.q: How do I switch the button to Ship it once everything passes?
faq.a: Change the `action` prop when all checks are `ok`, for example `{ label: 'Ship it', icon: 'rocket', accent: true }`. The demo does this.
